selection: Every run found under the results directory is included. None was dropped.
interpretation: Each seed is one simulated cohort with its own fitted models. The spread across seeds describes these simulated cohorts; it is not a confidence interval and says nothing about any real system.

combined.description: Everything on: delays, revisions, delayed outcomes, several encounters, site differences.

corrections.description: Some observations are later corrected or withdrawn. No delays.

delayed_labs.description: Laboratory results become available after a delay. Nothing else is on.

delayed_outcomes.description: Outcomes are ascertained after a delay. Features are unaffected.

multiple_encounters.description: Patients can have several encounters. No delays or revisions.

negative_control.description: No delays, no revisions, one encounter per patient. Every policy must agree.

site_variation.description: Delayed laboratory results, with measurement frequency, delays and pipeline cadence that differ by site.
